event_data: {"node_id": "partner.talk.help.noJob.notAtHelm", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:17:22+00:00", "text_string": "We need to head to a research station and take a job!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.noJob.afterSamArticle", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:17:35+00:00", "text_string": "Hey, Ollie! I was just chatting with your mom."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.noJob.afterSamArticle", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:17:40+00:00", "text_string": "Is it true that you've got a friend on the Challenger Deep mission?"}

{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.noJob.afterSamArticle", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:17:43+00:00", "text_string": "My friend Ex is on that mission, too! She was out here a few months ago, studying snow algae."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.noJob.afterSamArticle", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:17:46+00:00", "text_string": "She's amazing. Your friend Sam is in good company."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.ContinueAfterConnected", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:17:55+00:00", "text_string": "Anyway, what can I do for you, Ollie?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:34+00:00", "text_string": "I'm excited to see you taking another job, Ollie!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:36+00:00", "text_string": "I've been trying to feed the Cod equal amounts of Algae and Diatoms..."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:39+00:00", "text_string": "But it seems like they're mostly going for the Diatoms."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:42+00:00", "text_string": "I'll send you the data we have collected so far."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:47+00:00", "text_string": "Our mechanic has been annoyed at all the Algae clogging up people's engines."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:50+00:00", "text_string": "Weird. Why do you think the Cod aren't eating the algae?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:54+00:00", "text_string": "That's what I need you to solve."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:56+00:00", "text_string": "Okay. Muy f\u00e1cil. I'll just head back to the AquaLab and use the Measurement Tank."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:18:59+00:00", "text_string": "Great. Let me know what you find!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.measureBoth", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:24:34+00:00", "text_string": "Adequate work, Ollie! You've gathered all the data you need."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.measureBoth", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:24:39+00:00", "text_string": "My data is inconclusive, O. I suggest reporting back to Dir. Juno."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:24:50+00:00", "text_string": "Hey, got anything to report for your current job?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:24:55+00:00", "text_string": "So... I got the rates we needed. But I'm not totally sure what they mean."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:24:59+00:00", "text_string": "Well, feeding rates can tell us a lot about how much energy a species needs."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.firstQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:25:03+00:00", "text_string": "If a species eats larger amounts of one species, it usually means that species is low on nutrition."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.firstQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:25:09+00:00", "text_string": "Oh... like how I need to eat about a million of Mom's kelp rolls in order to feel full."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.firstQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:25:18+00:00", "text_string": "Exactly. So according to your data, which species is more nutritious for the Cod?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.diatomQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:25:31+00:00", "text_string": "Okay, let's verify that. How do the rates compare?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.revise", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:03+00:00", "text_string": "Oh... actually, Ollie, these rates show the opposite."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.revise", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:07+00:00", "text_string": "High nutrition means lower rates, because the Cod won't need to eat as much of it."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.revise", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:10+00:00", "text_string": "Low nutrition means higher rates, because the Cod need to eat a lot to fill up."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.firstQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:12+00:00", "text_string": "If a species eats larger amounts of one species, it usually means that species is low on nutrition."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.firstQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:15+00:00", "text_string": "Oh... like how I need to eat about a million of Mom's kelp rolls in order to feel full."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.firstQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:20+00:00", "text_string": "Exactly. So according to your data, which species is more nutritious for the Cod?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.algaeQuery", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:30+00:00", "text_string": "Okay, let's double check. How do the rates compare?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:26:58+00:00", "text_string": "Amazing job, Ollie! Looks like the Cod aren't eating much Ice Algae because small amounts provide a lot of nutrition."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:27:05+00:00", "text_string": "Wow. The Ice Algae must be, like, an Arctic Cod protein shake."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:27:14+00:00", "text_string": "I wonder if this has anything to do with what happened to that missing whale..."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-picky-eaters.argue.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:27:15+00:00", "text_string": "Anyway, thanks for your help, Ollie. I owe you one."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:27:31+00:00", "text_string": "Hey, want to see the Job Board?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:28:07+00:00", "text_string": "Okay, I'm ready to figure out what's going on with those mysterious Glass Sponges!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:28:11+00:00", "text_string": "They seemed so happy at Site X, but there are none here at Site Z."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:28:19+00:00", "text_string": "Apart from the light conditions, Site X and Site Z are similar... and sponges don't react poorly to light."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:28:25+00:00", "text_string": "What do you think is happening to them?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:28:27+00:00", "text_string": "Usually organisms are missing if they're too stressed to stick around, or if something eats all of them."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:28:33+00:00", "text_string": "You'll need to figure out if either of these are true for the sponges."}

{"node_id": "partner.talk.experiment.behavior.idle.nothingLeft.2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:32:24+00:00", "text_string": "You've been pretty thorough here! I doubt we'll learn anything more from this experiment."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.experimentCompleteZ", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:42:29+00:00", "text_string": "None of these predators seem to eat Glass Sponges... but I feel like I've seen some half-eaten Glass Sponges lying around."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.experimentCompleteZ", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:42:37+00:00", "text_string": "Yes. It is, as humans might say, perplexing."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.experimentCompleteZ", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:42:44+00:00", "text_string": "I'd recommend checking in with Dir. Juno. Maybe she'll have a new idea."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:43:01+00:00", "text_string": "So, do you have anything to report for your current job?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.main-question", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:43:06+00:00", "text_string": "What can you tell us about our two main theories regarding why there are no Glass Sponges in the Frosted Sea?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.lightClaim", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:43:30+00:00", "text_string": "What information do you have related to the current light levels at Site Z?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.giveUpArgument", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:07+00:00", "text_string": "No worries, Ollie. Just let me know when you're ready!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.catchDiscussFindings", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:12+00:00", "text_string": "Return to the research station and report your findings to Dir. Juno!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic_alt.jobGiver.wrongCharacter.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:16+00:00", "text_string": "Hmm... looks like your current job is with Dir. Juno."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic_alt.jobGiver.wrongCharacter.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:18+00:00", "text_string": "You should talk to her about that."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:19+00:00", "text_string": "Hey, got anything to report for your current job?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.main-question", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:26+00:00", "text_string": "What can you tell us about our two main theories regarding why there are no Glass Sponges in the Frosted Sea?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.predatorComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:37+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, that's interesting! Then there must be something else going on."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.main-question", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:44:40+00:00", "text_string": "What can you tell us about our two main theories regarding why there are no Glass Sponges in the Frosted Sea?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.predatorClaim", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:45:03+00:00", "text_string": "I thought we already talked about this, Ollie. There are no predators that eat Glass Sponges in Site Z."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.main-question", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:45:06+00:00", "text_string": "What can you tell us about our two main theories regarding why there are no Glass Sponges in the Frosted Sea?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.lightClaim", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:45:10+00:00", "text_string": "What information do you have related to the current light levels at Site Z?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.lightComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:45:54+00:00", "text_string": "From what you've shown me, these light levels seem fine. So something else must be going on."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.bothComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:45:58+00:00", "text_string": "Hmmm. I can see you've done your research, but we still don't have an answer."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.bothComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:46:01+00:00", "text_string": "Ugh. I don't get it. \u00a1Esto es imposible! How do you stay so patient?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.bothComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:46:07+00:00", "text_string": "Let's dig a little deeper. We know there are plenty of Glass Sponges at Site X, and none of them at Site Z."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.bothComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:46:13+00:00", "text_string": "Could something be happening to them on the way?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.bothComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:46:16+00:00", "text_string": "Exactly. A predator at Site Y may be eating all the Glass Sponges before they can go any farther."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.groundwork.bothComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:46:23+00:00", "text_string": "That may be a good place to check out next."}
{"node_id": "partner.talk.experiment.behavior.idle.nothingLeft.1", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:52:48+00:00", "text_string": "I think we've learned all that we can from this experiment."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.experimentCompleteAll", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:53:52+00:00", "text_string": "Finally! We've found a species that eats Glass Sponges!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.experimentCompleteAll", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:53:55+00:00", "text_string": "And you've already counted the population of Cushion Stars at Site Y."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.predatorComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:53:57+00:00", "text_string": "Sounds like it's time to show Dir. Juno what you've found!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:54:12+00:00", "text_string": "So, do you have anything to report for your current job?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.main-question", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:54:15+00:00", "text_string": "Have you found any predators between Site X and Site Z that could be stopping the Glass Sponges from reaching the Frosted Sea?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:25+00:00", "text_string": "So the Cushion Stars eat all the Glass Sponges at Site Y, before they can make it here to Site Z."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:30+00:00", "text_string": "This was a tricky one! I'm impressed by your persistence."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:33+00:00", "text_string": "Ha. My mom would call it stubbornness."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:35+00:00", "text_string": "Well, whatever you want to call it, your sister was the same way."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:39+00:00", "text_string": "I'll pass on what we learned to my colleagues in Norway\u2014\u2014they're studying Cushion Stars, too."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:48+00:00", "text_string": "I talk to people all over, Ollie. Our whole network of scientists is connected."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-isolated-instnace.argue.final.complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:55:55+00:00", "text_string": "Thanks again for your help. If you ever want another job, just let me know!"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:30+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, this is great, Ollie! I've been curious about the Ribbon Seals for so long."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:33+00:00", "text_string": "Though I can't promise you'll see one. They're a pretty rare find."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:40+00:00", "text_string": "It's true. Your sister called them loners... like a lot of us here."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:42+00:00", "text_string": "I've never seen one, but Juno here has stumbled upon them once or twice--"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:44+00:00", "text_string": "Wait. My sister told you about them??"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:46+00:00", "text_string": "Of course. Legend says she was the first to spot a Ribbon Seal around here."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:49+00:00", "text_string": "To start with, you'll need to venture below the ice and track down a Ribbon Seal."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:56:51+00:00", "text_string": "You may need to use your Ice Breaker to reach all parts of the Ephemeral Impasse."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.beforeSpeciesClaim", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:02:44+00:00", "text_string": "I can see why seals might like to cozy up in there."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.showClaimSpecies", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:02:47+00:00", "text_string": "What about microscopic species? Did you find any?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.completeSpecies", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:03:20+00:00", "text_string": "Wow, so many microorganisms! Nice job, Ollie."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.completeSpecies", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:03:21+00:00", "text_string": "And I can't believe you saw a Ribbon Seal! I've been here 6 years and I've seen one maybe twice."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.completeSpecies", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:03:27+00:00", "text_string": "Really? I find it comforting. All that ice and quiet."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.completeSpecies", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:03:29+00:00", "text_string": "But if ice crevices aren't your thing, no biggie. I'm sure I can find someone else for the next job--"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-seal-habbits.argue.completeSpecies", "server_time": "2026-01-01T13:03:31+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, there's another job down there?? What is it? When do I leave?"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:13:49+00:00", "text_string": "....Did you just make a joke, V1ct0r?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:13:52+00:00", "text_string": "Because I gotta say, it was pretty good."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:13:56+00:00", "text_string": "We need to gather the historical population data."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:13:59+00:00", "text_string": "See if you can track down the population probe."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.probeCollectionComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:02+00:00", "text_string": "Presentable work, O! You've gathered the data we need."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.probeCollectionComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:05+00:00", "text_string": "Your next priority is to measure the reproductive rates of kelp."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-refuge-failure.probeCollectionComplete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:08+00:00", "text_string": "Head to the surface and go to your Experiment Room."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:32+00:00", "text_string": "The transmission size was too large, so only a portion of the image came through."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:36+00:00", "text_string": "So what are we looking at here?"}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:37+00:00", "text_string": "It appears that this is only the eye of a much larger creature."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:39+00:00", "text_string": "V1ct0r, what are we going to do? Sam is down there with a monster!"}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:45+00:00", "text_string": "T\u00edo! Please tell me you've got good news!"}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:47+00:00", "text_string": "S\u00ed, mijita. I found the Ammonite upgrade for V1ct0r!"}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:54+00:00", "text_string": "Mer had stored the upgrade on an old data card of hers."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:14:58+00:00", "text_string": "Took forever to find... had to dig through all her old boxes."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.specterTrigger.8", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:15:01+00:00", "text_string": "Come talk to me at the Forested Lagoon, and I'll get the upgrade added to your card!"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.askForUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:16:54+00:00", "text_string": "So, mijita. Ready to upgrade V1ct0r and rescue Sam?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.discussUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:03+00:00", "text_string": "The Ammonite Upgrade should unscramble all of Sam's messages!"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.discussUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:08+00:00", "text_string": "I'm uploading it to your data card now."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.discussUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:11+00:00", "text_string": "I've also linked the upgrade to our job board here..."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.discussUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:13+00:00", "text_string": "Which means any jobs that Sam tries to send out should be able to reach us."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.discussUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:18+00:00", "text_string": "Don't thank me yet, mijita. First you'd better see if it worked."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.discussUpgrade", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:21+00:00", "text_string": "Take a look at the anomalies in AQOS, and head to the Helm on your ship to use your data card."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:39+00:00", "text_string": "Welcome back, mijita. Need any upgrades for your ship?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.open.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:46+00:00", "text_string": "Anything you want to learn more about?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.openScience.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:17:49+00:00", "text_string": "Do you need any new tools for your lab?"}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:01+00:00", "text_string": "All right, let's see what this upgrade T\u00edo gave me can do."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:10+00:00", "text_string": "Things are bad down here, O. We're in big trouble."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:17+00:00", "text_string": "Sam!! Can you hear me? Are you okay?"}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:20+00:00", "text_string": "It appears the communication is one-way. They cannot hear you."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:22+00:00", "text_string": "Ugh. I'm probably talking to nobody right now."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:26+00:00", "text_string": "But in case you can hear this, O...."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:29+00:00", "text_string": "The creature is back. Won't leave us alone."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:32+00:00", "text_string": "Systems are crashing. Lab's still out of commission. We're running out of time."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:35+00:00", "text_string": "I'm sending you the job. Please, O. If you get this\u2014we need help."}
{"node_id": "Helm.finalJobRadio", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:18:38+00:00", "text_string": "We need some way to get rid of this thing."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:00+00:00", "text_string": "Mom, Sam is in danger. I need to go save them!"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:01+00:00", "text_string": "Mija, I told you. It's too dangerous."}

{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:04+00:00", "text_string": "I'll put together a more experienced team to check on the Nautilus. It should only take a few days."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:08+00:00", "text_string": "We don't have a few days, Mom. Sam needs help now!"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:13+00:00", "text_string": "You can't go down there. You don't even know how to help!"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:15+00:00", "text_string": "Not yet, but I can figure it out."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.tryTellMom", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:19:21+00:00", "text_string": "If you can figure out how to save Sam, come talk to me again."}

{"node_id": "job.final-final.modelCompleted", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:02+00:00", "text_string": "Based on this data, predators in the deep consume mainly bioluminescent and light-colored organisms."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.modelCompleted", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:05+00:00", "text_string": "Red organisms appear to have natural camouflage."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.modelCompleted", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:06+00:00", "text_string": "That's it! The key to saving Sam!"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.modelCompleted", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:10+00:00", "text_string": "And Mom said that if I figure this out... I could go help."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.modelCompleted", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:15+00:00", "text_string": "Come on, V1ct0r. We need to get back to the Station!"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.chooseClaimModel", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:32+00:00", "text_string": "Okay, Olivia. If I let you go down there, how would you help Sam?"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.lights", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:20:46+00:00", "text_string": "Olivia, it's completely dark down there. Sam would never make it out without a light source."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.chooseFactsEat", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:21:25+00:00", "text_string": "How does the color red make a difference to the attacker?"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.incorrectFactsEat", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:02+00:00", "text_string": "Are you sure this is what you wanted to show me?"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.incorrectFactsEat", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:04+00:00", "text_string": "You're not making sense. I really wish you'd drop this subject."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.chooseFactsEat", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:06+00:00", "text_string": "How does the color red make a difference to the attacker?"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:34+00:00", "text_string": "Red light doesn't reach those depths, so red species don't reflect any light."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:41+00:00", "text_string": "I suppose it's a little too late for a red paint job now."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:44+00:00", "text_string": "But if Sam switches on their red lights, the creature won't be able to see them."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:49+00:00", "text_string": "I'll pass on this information to the rescue team."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:51+00:00", "text_string": "What?! Mom, we don't have time to organize a rescue team. I need to go now!"}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:22:55+00:00", "text_string": "I've already lost one child to this foolishness."}
{"node_id": "job.final-final.argue.endArgue", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:23:05+00:00", "text_string": "I'm sorry, Mija. I have to make sure you stay safe."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:23:28+00:00", "text_string": "Welcome back, mijita. Need any upgrades for your ship?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:24:29+00:00", "text_string": "Mom stole my card. The AquaLab is dead in the water."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:24:34+00:00", "text_string": "How could she do this?? She doesn't even care if Sam lives or dies!"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:24:44+00:00", "text_string": "I don't understand. What does Mer have to do with this?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:24:47+00:00", "text_string": "Your sister's death... it wasn't an equipment malfunction."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:24:53+00:00", "text_string": "She was on her way back from placing the Challenger Deep..."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:24:58+00:00", "text_string": "And she came upon a whale caught in a fishing net."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:04+00:00", "text_string": "Mer couldn't let it die. She swam out to cut it free."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:09+00:00", "text_string": "That sounds like Mer. She loved whales so much."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:13+00:00", "text_string": "Yes. But... Ollie, the whale didn't know any better. It panicked. Called out for help."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:23+00:00", "text_string": "But your sister never made it back from the Lower Depths."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:32+00:00", "text_string": "That's why Mom doesn't want me going down there."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:35+00:00", "text_string": "Your mother doesn't want to lose you."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:25:49+00:00", "text_string": "I've transferred V1ct0r's upgrade to Mer's old data card."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.restorePower", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:26:01+00:00", "text_string": "This should get you where you need to go."}
{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:26:45+00:00", "text_string": "Auto-pilot destination set for The Lower Depths."}
{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:26:47+00:00", "text_string": "We will arrive at our destination tomorrow."}
{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:26:49+00:00", "text_string": "Great. I'm going to get some sleep."}
{"node_id": "Dream07.mer07Trigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:28:10+00:00", "text_string": "Mer, don't do that! It's too dangerous!  "}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.EighthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:28:52+00:00", "text_string": "Good morning, O. We have arrived at our destination."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.EighthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:28:57+00:00", "text_string": "We are prepared to descend to the Lower Depths."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.EighthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:28:59+00:00", "text_string": "Due to the uncertain nature of this mission, I am unable to calculate your odds of survival."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.EighthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:29:04+00:00", "text_string": "I know, V1ct0r. It's worth the risk."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Cave.teethTrigger", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:34:57+00:00", "text_string": "Negative. I am incapable of hallucinating which is what you are currently doing."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Cave.teethTrigger", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:35:01+00:00", "text_string": "You are experiencing visual hallucinations as a result of low oxygen. This is called hypoxia."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.stationEnter", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:35:59+00:00", "text_string": "We have arrived at the Challenger Deep research location. Oxygen Levels Restored."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.stationEnter", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:36:04+00:00", "text_string": "Great, I will pretend I wasn't just swallowed by a monster."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:36:28+00:00", "text_string": "Wow. V1ct0r, that's the Challenger Deep. Mer's life's work!"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:36:30+00:00", "text_string": "Affirmative. This probe contains 10 years of deep-sea data."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.firstScanChallengerDeep", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:36:37+00:00", "text_string": "I would not recommend activating the probe now, O."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.firstScanChallengerDeep", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:36:41+00:00", "text_string": "The lights are extremely bright and might attract the creature."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.firstScanChallengerDeep", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:36:42+00:00", "text_string": "Right. I don't have time to stop, anyway. We need to find Sam!"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:32+00:00", "text_string": "Sam, I solved it! You need to turn on your red lights."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:38+00:00", "text_string": "Those bright lights are drawing the squid right to you!"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:41+00:00", "text_string": "O, do you copy?! We're running out of air!"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:46+00:00", "text_string": "The Nautilus's systems are heavily damaged. They cannot receive transmissions."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:48+00:00", "text_string": "Oh no. There's no way to get inside and warn them. We'd be crushed!"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:51+00:00", "text_string": "Affirmative. You must lure the squid away from the station."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:53+00:00", "text_string": "What if I turn on my lights to distract it?"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:37:55+00:00", "text_string": "Turning on your flashlight now would result in imminent death."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:02+00:00", "text_string": "As much as I love data, it is unlikely that more data would help us right now."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:07+00:00", "text_string": "No! I mean, what if I turn the probe on??"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:12+00:00", "text_string": "We can't make the station red, but we can create a big, blinking diversion."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:18+00:00", "text_string": "In that case, the probe lights would draw the squid away."}

{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:21+00:00", "text_string": "But there is a 99.8% chance that the creature would destroy the Challenger Deep. All of your sister's work would be lost."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:30+00:00", "text_string": "Mer's gone. But I can still save Sam."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:38:34+00:00", "text_string": "Sam, if you can hear me, I'm turning on the probe to draw the squid away!"}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.activationScanChallengerDeep", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:52:18+00:00", "text_string": "Here we go! Activating the Challenger Deep."}
{"node_id": "RS-0-Final.samFinalTrigger3", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:52:38+00:00", "text_string": "The Challenger Deep signal has been lost."}
{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:52:47+00:00", "text_string": "How did you get past the squid??"}
{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:52:48+00:00", "text_string": "It's... a long story. I'm just glad you're okay."}
{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:52:51+00:00", "text_string": "You're O? I've heard SO much about you!"}

{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:52:57+00:00", "text_string": "Sam said you're one of the most brilliant people they've ever met... just needed a little dose of confidence."}
{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:53:11+00:00", "text_string": "Ahem. This is very sweet and all...."}
{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:53:16+00:00", "text_string": "But can we take this little chat to the surface?"}
{"node_id": "interior.RS-0-Station.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T14:53:19+00:00", "text_string": "Yeah. Let's get out of here... before that thing comes back."}

{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:01:42+00:00", "text_string": "Here? But... what about the Nautilus mission?"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:01:44+00:00", "text_string": "I want to help find the Challenger Deep!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:01:46+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, Mija. I'm sorry. That mission already left last night."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:01:49+00:00", "text_string": "Besides, the Lower Depths are too dangerous."}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:01:51+00:00", "text_string": "You can do so much good right here!"}
{"node_id": "act1.momMadEnd", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:01:52+00:00", "text_string": "Sun's almost up. Let's get you started with your first job."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:02:24+00:00", "text_string": "The data on your new ID card will give you clearance."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:02:26+00:00", "text_string": "Just make sure not to lose your card, or the whole ship will power down."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:03:01+00:00", "text_string": "My name is Version 1 Conscious Terminal Onboard Representative."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:03:10+00:00", "text_string": "Oh... my name's Olivia Ramirez, but my friends call me O."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:03:12+00:00", "text_string": "So... what should we do first, V1ct0r?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:03:14+00:00", "text_string": "First, we will need to collect some data. My favorite!!!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:03:16+00:00", "text_string": "Use your Scanner to identify all the species here at the Forested Lagoon."}

{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:08:40+00:00", "text_string": "Olivia! Do you need help with something?"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:08:48+00:00", "text_string": "I've got a recipe for cinnamon kelp rolls that I've been dying to try..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:08:51+00:00", "text_string": "Ok, Mija. Let's see what behaviors you discovered about the species here at Site C!"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.done", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:09:12+00:00", "text_string": "Excellent work. You just explained the basis of the Forested Lagoon Food Web!"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:09:24+00:00", "text_string": "For now, I'd rather have you stay closer to home. Just in case."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:18+00:00", "text_string": "Dr. Harper and Silias have been driving me crazy."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:20+00:00", "text_string": "Ha. My mom would say they need a mental health break. Maybe some ginger-kelp cookies."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:25+00:00", "text_string": "I got to meet her once, at an event for girls in oceanic tech."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:29+00:00", "text_string": "Mer and I used to collect those when I was a kid."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:32+00:00", "text_string": "I used to have an old article about her taped up on my wall."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:34+00:00", "text_string": "I can try to dig it up, if you want."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.bayou.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T21:51:36+00:00", "text_string": "Well... I've probably fangirled enough. Wanna take a look at my shop?"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:16:47+00:00", "text_string": "We are beginning an assessment of whether the oil rig reef can stay without harming the ecosystem, or if it needs to be removed."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:16:51+00:00", "text_string": "The first step is to estimate organism populations."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:16:53+00:00", "text_string": "That will allow us to compare the populations of native species to the invasive species that the rig has enabled to live here."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:16:55+00:00", "text_string": "We'll also be able to use that data as a baseline for future models."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:16:57+00:00", "text_string": "Can you take your sub out and get an estimated count of all the species here?"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.bayou.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:17:02+00:00", "text_string": "Hey, got anything to report for your current job?"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue1", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:17:08+00:00", "text_string": "Okay Ollie, let's analyze the data you uncovered for the species at ERC Industries Rig."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue1", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:17:11+00:00", "text_string": "First, what are the populations for the native species: Loggerhead Turtles and Red Grouper? (They should be in the Sites tab of AQOS.)"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:17:31+00:00", "text_string": "How about the populations of organisms that rely on the rig structure? Those are Elkhorn Coral and Sea Pearls."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.loadArgue3", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:17:46+00:00", "text_string": "What other species are there? Those will be the invasive species."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:17:59+00:00", "text_string": "Okay, so you estimate about 15 turtles and 15 grouper."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:01+00:00", "text_string": "That's 30 of the native species overall. And you estimate about 40 Angelfish, which are invasive species."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:04+00:00", "text_string": "I would call that about even, maybe a few more invasives. That worries me, because it seems they are set to crowd out the native species."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:12+00:00", "text_string": "We'll need to keep an eye on whether the Angelfish populations increase or remain stable."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:15+00:00", "text_string": "I need to consider this and plan our next move."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:16+00:00", "text_string": "Aw, you gotta be kiddin' me, Harper."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:18+00:00", "text_string": "The turtles were here first. Then these new critters moved in and started takin' over."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:20+00:00", "text_string": "If you ask me, we need that reef outta here yesterday! Right, kid?"}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:24+00:00", "text_string": "I'm not really used to making these kind of decisions..."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:26+00:00", "text_string": "It's too early to decide anything, Silias. We need more data."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.argue.analysis4Complete", "server_time": "2026-01-01T22:18:30+00:00", "text_string": "Ollie, let me know if you'd like to help out again. I'm sure I'll have more work for you soon."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.experimentFinished", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:54:22+00:00", "text_string": "Okay. How do I get back there, V1ct0r?"}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.experimentFinished", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:54:23+00:00", "text_string": "You can go to your Helm and board your sub, or you can open your schematic and use Quick-Travel to get there faster!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:54:41+00:00", "text_string": "Olivia! Do you need help with something?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:54:46+00:00", "text_string": "This is so exciting! Your first job!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:54:49+00:00", "text_string": "I've got a recipe for cinnamon kelp rolls that I've been dying to try..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.hello", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:54:52+00:00", "text_string": "Ok, Mija. Let's see what behaviors you discovered about the species here at Site C!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.otter", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:03+00:00", "text_string": "Looks good! The Sea Otters eat Urchins. Did you learn anything about what the Urchins eat?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.argue.done", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:15+00:00", "text_string": "Excellent work. You just explained the basis of the Forested Lagoon Food Web!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:18+00:00", "text_string": "With your help, we might actually be able to get the Kelp Refuge up and running!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:21+00:00", "text_string": "Your sister used to love this place. I can't think of a better way to honor her."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:22+00:00", "text_string": "What about the other research stations? Do they need help, too?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:25+00:00", "text_string": "For now, I'd rather have you stay closer to home. Just in case."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:28+00:00", "text_string": "Never mind, Sweetie. Let's get you set up with your next job!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:31+00:00", "text_string": "Talk to me to view your Job Board whenever you're ready."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:46+00:00", "text_string": "Would you like to see the Job Board, Mija?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:55+00:00", "text_string": "Okay, Mija. You already identified all the species here at Site C."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:55:58+00:00", "text_string": "Now you'll need to head to Site A, Rodeo Cove, and do the same thing."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:56:38+00:00", "text_string": "Wow, Rodeo Cove! My sister used to bring me here when I was little."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:56:40+00:00", "text_string": "I wonder if Ovid the Otter still lives here. He was my favorite."}

{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:56:42+00:00", "text_string": "According to my database, male sea otters live an average of 10 to 15 years in the wild..."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:56:43+00:00", "text_string": "So there is a 15.8% chance that Ovid is still alive!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.diveSite", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:56:45+00:00", "text_string": "Gee. Thanks for that cheery thought, V1ct0r."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.helpAtSiteA", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:56:59+00:00", "text_string": "Scan any new species you can find, and then head back to your ship."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.helpGoToLab", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:57:57+00:00", "text_string": "You have completed your task! Now head to your ship's Experiment Lab."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.helpGoToLab", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:57:59+00:00", "text_string": "The first step is to return to the surface and board your ship."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-01-01T11:59:59+00:00", "text_string": "Wonderful, Mija! And you're back so soon!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.introQuestion", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:01+00:00", "text_string": "What behaviors did you learn about Bull Kelp in Site A?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.argue.done", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:12+00:00", "text_string": "Just like here at the Forested Lagoon, Sea Otters eat the Urchins."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:15+00:00", "text_string": "You've proven that both Bull Kelp and Giant Kelp provide energy to their ecosystems."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:18+00:00", "text_string": "Does that mean I can take a job at another station?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:19+00:00", "text_string": "Well... if that's what you really want."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:21+00:00", "text_string": "But are you sure you don't want to stay here? You're still so new at this."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:23+00:00", "text_string": "No te preocupes, Mom. I'll be careful."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:26+00:00", "text_string": "I'll have V1ct0r update the map aboard your AquaLab."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-bull-kelp-forest.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:28+00:00", "text_string": "In the meantime, stop by your uncle's shop. You'll need some upgrades."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:47+00:00", "text_string": "What do you think of V1ct0r? Pretty sweet A.I., right?"}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:49+00:00", "text_string": "His love of data was Mer's idea."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:52+00:00", "text_string": "\u00a1Claro que s\u00ed! Didn't I tell you?"}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.ContinueAfterTioVictorJournal", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:00:59+00:00", "text_string": "Now that you and V1ct0r will be traveling outside the Kelp Forest, you'll need some upgrades."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:18+00:00", "text_string": "When you move close to a species you've already scanned, Population Count Mode will count them."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.ROVTagger", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:21+00:00", "text_string": "MUCH faster than counting each critter by hand."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.unlockHintSomewhere", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:24+00:00", "text_string": "This would unlock some jobs over at the Coral Reef Research Station!"}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.VisualModel", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:37+00:00", "text_string": "The Visual Modeling! Every scientist needs one of these."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.item.VisualModel", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:40+00:00", "text_string": "Use it to create visual models and understand the interactions between species."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.kelp.unlockHintSomewhere", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:42+00:00", "text_string": "This would unlock some jobs over at the Coral Reef Research Station!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.gotBothModels", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:01:51+00:00", "text_string": "Nice! Let's head back to the Ship then."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-shop-welcome.end", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:02:11+00:00", "text_string": "I can't believe Mom's letting me leave the Forested Lagoon... by myself!!"}

{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.1", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:03:30+00:00", "text_string": "Thanks, V1ct0r. I'm going to get some sleep."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:00+00:00", "text_string": "Good morning, O! We have arrived at the Arctic Station."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:02+00:00", "text_string": "My sensors indicate you are experiencing stress."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:03+00:00", "text_string": "Yeah. I just had the weirdest dream."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FirstDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:04+00:00", "text_string": "Just give me a second... I need to write this down."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:17+00:00", "text_string": "Wait a second... V1ct0r, is that my sister's old trunk?"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:20+00:00", "text_string": "Wow. She used to keep so many notes and sketches in there!"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:22+00:00", "text_string": "Would you like me to digitally scan its contents, O?"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.TrunkSequence", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:05:24+00:00", "text_string": "I think I'd like to look through it on my own."}

{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.generic.tagger.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:06:14+00:00", "text_string": "Once you've scanned a species, switch to the Population Count Mode and move close to one of them to count it."}

{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.generic.tagger.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:06:15+00:00", "text_string": "Count enough of them and your Population Count Mode will do the rest and give you a population estimate."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:06:45+00:00", "text_string": "Welcome to the Arctic Station. I'm the lead scientist here. You can call me Juno."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:05+00:00", "text_string": "Welcome to the Arctic Station. I'm the lead scientist here. You can call me Juno."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:06+00:00", "text_string": "Um... yeah. How do you know my name?"}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:08+00:00", "text_string": "Professor Whalen here used to work with your sister. You look just like her."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:12+00:00", "text_string": "Wait... for real? You taught my sister?"}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:13+00:00", "text_string": "Taught her? No. Mer was a prodigy. I could barely keep up."}

{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:52+00:00", "text_string": "She used to leave her notes scattered all around this place. I'll see if I can find any of them."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:55+00:00", "text_string": "Have you lived out here all this time, Professor?"}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:57+00:00", "text_string": "No. I'm only here for one task... seeking out a Bowhead Whale that I've lost track of."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:14:59+00:00", "text_string": "I would love your help. I sure have been worried about her."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:10+00:00", "text_string": "Thank you, Ollie! No one ever offers to help with the salmon estimates."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:14+00:00", "text_string": "It looks like you already counted the current salmon populations."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:16+00:00", "text_string": "Sure, once. That means it's time to count again."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:18+00:00", "text_string": "\u00bfEn serio? You count them twice, every time?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:20+00:00", "text_string": "Yep. My work requires detailed, long-term monitoring of the salmon. It's fascinating!"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:23+00:00", "text_string": "The counts don't have to be exactly the same, but we want to verify our data is reasonably accurate."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:25+00:00", "text_string": "I'll take care of it, if you're too busy--I'm used to handling things myself."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:30+00:00", "text_string": "We do counts like this all the time back at my mom's station. I'm basically an expert."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T12:15:32+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, that's perfect! Let me know what you find!"}
{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:56:57+00:00", "text_string": "Auto-pilot destination set for Great Channel Kelp Forest."}
{"node_id": "WorldMap.WorldMapLeaving.2", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:57:04+00:00", "text_string": "We will arrive at our destination tomorrow."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FourthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:05+00:00", "text_string": "I am here. How can I help you, O?"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FourthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:05+00:00", "text_string": "Um... nothing. Just wanted to make sure you were still there."}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.FourthDream", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:06+00:00", "text_string": "Let's get off this ship and take on a new job. I need to be around people."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.articleAfterTransmission", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:29+00:00", "text_string": "The Oceanic Times did a profile on your friend!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.articleAfterTransmission", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:32+00:00", "text_string": "Here, take a look! Such a nice photo of them."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.ContinueAfterSamArticle", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:50+00:00", "text_string": "I know you wanted to go on that mission, too."}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.ContinueAfterSamArticle", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:51+00:00", "text_string": "But you're doing such an amazing job here. I'm so grateful for your help!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.kelp.jobGiver.noJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:58:55+00:00", "text_string": "Would you like to see the Job Board, Mija?"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:03+00:00", "text_string": "Thank you for taking this job, Olivia!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:04+00:00", "text_string": "It's been so hard to keep up with everything."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:04+00:00", "text_string": "Yeah... the station's been pretty empty lately."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:05+00:00", "text_string": "Our people keep getting called away to other stations."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:06+00:00", "text_string": "Not that I blame them, of course. There's just not enough scientists."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:09+00:00", "text_string": "The mussels at the Forested Lagoon look strange."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:09+00:00", "text_string": "I need to find out if something is stressing them."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.start", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:11+00:00", "text_string": "Head outside to site C, and V1ct0r will guide you from there."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-mussel-fest.helpScan", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:59:32+00:00", "text_string": "Can you remind me what to do next, V1ct0r?"}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:09:55+00:00", "text_string": "So this is the Descriptive Model! This is where all your facts get turned into a big simulation."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:09:57+00:00", "text_string": "What that practically means is we have a bunch of virtual organisms interacting with each other."}
{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:09:58+00:00", "text_string": "And their interactions are driven by the facts you have."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:00+00:00", "text_string": "So if you've got a fact that says \"Urchins eat Giant Kelp\", then these virtual Urchins will eat the virtual Giant Kelp."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:01+00:00", "text_string": "More than that, though, you can use the population histories you download from various sites."}
{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:03+00:00", "text_string": "Those histories are represented on the graph by thick faded lines."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:05+00:00", "text_string": "As your virtual organisms eat, and die, and reproduce, their populations will show up on the graph too."}
{"node_id": "modeling.generic.sync-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:06+00:00", "text_string": "Your goal is to get those lines to line up with the historical populations!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-urchin-barren-predict.ModelSynced", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:11+00:00", "text_string": "Ah! Look at all this wonderful data!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-urchin-barren-predict.ModelSynced", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:12+00:00", "text_string": "Aww, V1ct0r. Now I know what to get you for your birthday."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-urchin-barren-predict.ModelSynced", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:15+00:00", "text_string": "The model's output is lining up with actual past population data."}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-urchin-barren-predict.ModelSynced", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:21+00:00", "text_string": "That means you've created a useful model!"}
{"node_id": "job.kelp-urchin-barren-predict.ModelSynced", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:22+00:00", "text_string": "Now you must see what it predicts will happen next. Use the Predict tab!"}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.prediction-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:25+00:00", "text_string": "Once we have a complete Describe Model, we can click the button that says Run Prediction."}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.prediction-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:27+00:00", "text_string": "This will provide us with a model forecasting what the site will look like in the future!"}

{"node_id": "modeling.generic.prediction-model.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-01T08:10:28+00:00", "text_string": "If you see dotted lines, those mean that you have observed relationships between organisms but you don't have the exact rates."}

{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:56:19+00:00", "text_string": "No need to worry, O. Serenity Meadows is perfectly safe."}
{"node_id": "interior.coralStation.intro.prof", "server_time": "2026-01-01T06:56:21+00:00", "text_string": "Unless you're allergic to Lionfish, like me. Then it's a death trap."}

{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:36+00:00", "text_string": "Welcome to the Arctic Station. I'm the lead scientist here. You can call me Juno."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:39+00:00", "text_string": "Um... yeah. How do you know my name?"}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:41+00:00", "text_string": "Professor Whalen here used to work with your sister. You look just like her."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:42+00:00", "text_string": "Wait... for real? You taught my sister?"}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:44+00:00", "text_string": "Taught her? No. Mer was a prodigy. I could barely keep up."}

{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:46+00:00", "text_string": "She used to leave her notes scattered all around this place. I'll see if I can find any of them."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:50+00:00", "text_string": "Have you lived out here all this time, Professor?"}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:52+00:00", "text_string": "No. I'm only here for one task... seeking out a Bowhead Whale that I've lost track of."}
{"node_id": "interior.arcticStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:36:55+00:00", "text_string": "I would love your help. I sure have been worried about her."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:55:52+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, thank you, Ollie. I've been worried sick about poor Linda."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:55:56+00:00", "text_string": "Our missing whale. One of the matriarchs of her pod."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:55:58+00:00", "text_string": "My team has been tracking the pod for some time now."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:55:59+00:00", "text_string": "Every year, they migrate through here before returning south."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:01+00:00", "text_string": "We checked Linda's tracking device, but it seems to have stopped transmitting."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:03+00:00", "text_string": "Aw, no te preocupes, Professor. I'm sure you'll see Linda again."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:04+00:00", "text_string": "I mean, how hard can it be to find a whale? They're not exactly small."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:06+00:00", "text_string": "I'll get out there and start searching."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:08+00:00", "text_string": "Linda's last known location was somewhere near Site W: White Point."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:10+00:00", "text_string": "Finding either her or her tracker would be most helpful."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:11+00:00", "text_string": "Do let me know what you find."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.enterScene", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:43+00:00", "text_string": "Okay. Let's do this. Can you scan for Linda's tracker, V1ct0r?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.enterScene", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:46+00:00", "text_string": "Yes! It appears we're picking up a faint signal."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.enterScene", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:47+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, that's amazing! Linda must be nearby!"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.enterScene", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:56:49+00:00", "text_string": "I told Professor Whalen we'd find her. He'll be so happy."}
{"node_id": "commonDiveSite.partner.onScan.probeHackerNotAcquired.1", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:57:04+00:00", "text_string": "I don't think we have the necessary equipment for this yet."}

{"node_id": "RS-4Y.emergeFromTheIce", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:59:30+00:00", "text_string": "It appears we were swept up in a current."}
{"node_id": "RS-4Y.emergeFromTheIce", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:59:31+00:00", "text_string": "No, I mean... what were all those creatures?"}
{"node_id": "RS-4Y.emergeFromTheIce", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:59:32+00:00", "text_string": "And what about that skeleton? Could it have been a whale?"}
{"node_id": "RS-4Y.emergeFromTheIce", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:59:33+00:00", "text_string": "It did appear to have the appropriate dimensions."}
{"node_id": "RS-4Y.emergeFromTheIce", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:59:36+00:00", "text_string": "We have no idea if that was Linda. We saw it for, like, three seconds."}
{"node_id": "RS-4Y.emergeFromTheIce", "server_time": "2026-01-02T14:59:39+00:00", "text_string": "We need more proof. Linda might be just fine."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.helpFindWhale", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:00:12+00:00", "text_string": "You will need to investigate Linda's remains."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.helpFindWhale", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:00:13+00:00", "text_string": "But first, you'll need a stronger engine."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.helpFindWhale", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:00:14+00:00", "text_string": "Otherwise that undersea current will keep sweeping you past the skeleton."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-missing-whale.helpFindWhale", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:00:17+00:00", "text_string": "Hmm. A stronger engine? I think I saw something in the shop like that."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.arctic.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:01:35+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, hi there! Welcome to my humble little shop."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.arctic.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:01:36+00:00", "text_string": "You're Meredith's sister, aren't ya? She musta been a lot older than you."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.arctic.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:01:38+00:00", "text_string": "What was that?? You'll have to speak up. I'm a little hard of hearing."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.arctic.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:01:41+00:00", "text_string": "Aw, I understand, Ollie. I've shed a lot of tears, too."}
{"node_id": "interior.shop.arctic.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:01:43+00:00", "text_string": "We're like a family around these parts."}

{"node_id": "interior.shop.arctic.shopOpen.first", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:01:49+00:00", "text_string": "Wanna take a look around my shop, Ollie?"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:11:53+00:00", "text_string": "Thank you, Ollie! No one ever offers to help with the salmon estimates."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:11:56+00:00", "text_string": "It looks like you already counted the current salmon populations."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:11:58+00:00", "text_string": "Sure, once. That means it's time to count again."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:00+00:00", "text_string": "\u00bfEn serio? You count them twice, every time?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:01+00:00", "text_string": "Yep. My work requires detailed, long-term monitoring of the salmon. It's fascinating!"}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:04+00:00", "text_string": "The counts don't have to be exactly the same, but we want to verify our data is reasonably accurate."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:06+00:00", "text_string": "I'll take care of it, if you're too busy--I'm used to handling things myself."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:08+00:00", "text_string": "We do counts like this all the time back at my mom's station. I'm basically an expert."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:10+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, that's perfect! Let me know what you find!"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.arctic.jobGiver.hasJob.a", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:21+00:00", "text_string": "Hey, got anything to report for your current job?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.mainQuestion", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:25+00:00", "text_string": "Did you finish counting the salmon? What did you find?"}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:50+00:00", "text_string": "Oh, this is great! Looks like the estimates are accurate."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:52+00:00", "text_string": "I like to keep a close eye on our salmon populations here."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:53+00:00", "text_string": "I totally get it. My mom is the same way with the Kelp and Otters back home."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:57+00:00", "text_string": "But outsiders usually leave this place as fast as possible."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:12:58+00:00", "text_string": "I mean, it is remote and extreme. And super cold."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:13:00+00:00", "text_string": "That's true. But I think I kind of love it."}

{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:13:01+00:00", "text_string": "Well, if you're gonna be helping out around here, I'll need to send you some preliminary data."}
{"node_id": "job.arctic-salmon-monitoring.argue.correctFacts", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:13:05+00:00", "text_string": "Here you go. Look for it in your AQOS!"}

{"node_id": "ship.cabin.SecondDream", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:26:06+00:00", "text_string": "We have arrived at a new ecosystem, full of fascinating data to collect!"}
{"node_id": "ship.cabin.SecondDream", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:26:12+00:00", "text_string": "Were you worried that it had been lost?"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:43+00:00", "text_string": "Well, well, well. Finally, some new blood around here!"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:45+00:00", "text_string": "Welcome to the Bayou Station, Ms. Ramirez."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:46+00:00", "text_string": "Thanks. You can call me Ollie, or just O."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:47+00:00", "text_string": "That reef out there, on the oil rig\u2014\u2014I've never seen anything like it."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:50+00:00", "text_string": "I've been stationed here to decide what needs to be done."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:52+00:00", "text_string": "Well, obviously the rig needs to go! Why are we wastin' time on this?"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:55+00:00", "text_string": "Silias, the rig is not your concern."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:56+00:00", "text_string": "I'm still waiting for your report on the comms tower mishap."}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:58+00:00", "text_string": "I keep tellin' ya, Professor. That explosion wasn't my fault!"}
{"node_id": "interior.bayouStation.intro", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:30:59+00:00", "text_string": "Wait a sec... your comms tower exploded??"}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:31:33+00:00", "text_string": "We are beginning an assessment of whether the oil rig reef can stay without harming the ecosystem, or if it needs to be removed."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:31:36+00:00", "text_string": "The first step is to estimate organism populations."}

{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:31:38+00:00", "text_string": "That will allow us to compare the populations of native species to the invasive species that the rig has enabled to live here."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:31:39+00:00", "text_string": "We'll also be able to use that data as a baseline for future models."}
{"node_id": "job.bayou-displaced-reef.start", "server_time": "2026-01-02T15:31:40+00:00", "text_string": "Can you take your sub out and get an estimated count of all the species here?"}
{"node_id": "interior.job.bayou_alt.jobGiver.wrongCharacter.a", "server_time": "2026-01-02T17:00:45+00:00", "text_string": "Bah, you've got a job with her."}
